verdict.rationale: Building custom AI agents is a fair question for a work-management SaaS like Trello, so the axis applies. However, the evidence contains no in-product agent builder or agent configuration. The nearby items do not qualify: the MCP server lets external AI tools connect to Trello, the AI writing assist is an adjacent feature, and Power-Ups, automation and the REST API are developer building blocks rather than a capability to create and configure one's own agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product
